page.layout: One title page: centred title lines at top, a woodcut engraving in the middle, publisher's imprint and date at the foot. No margins with text.

main_text.l: præcipuè temporibus, quibus per Satanam, uaq; organa,
E Gallica in Latinam translatus linguam.
Cum INDICE triplice, Quaestionum scilicet; & Obiectionum
quibus hic respondetur; Rerum item memorabilium

page.notes: The date line reads "M. DC. IIX." as printed; probably MDCIX (1609) with a printing error. The woodcut shows a female figure with a book, grapes and a banner reading LABORA ET ORA (partly visible), and is not transcribed. Small ornaments and stray marks are omitted.
